professionalSummary.text: Designed load scenarios for batch and online components of a credit monitoring platform, collecting CPU, memory, and database wait metrics using the team's performance test platform.
professionalSummary.witness: Designed the load scenarios for the utilisation batch and the early-warning online queries using the team's performance test platform, collecting CPU, memory and database wait metrics for each run.

professionalSummary.text: Analysed latency distributions for online queries, identified a p95 bottleneck due to a missing index on the facility table, and documented findings in a release performance report with before-and-after measurements.
professionalSummary.witness: Analysed latency distributions for the online queries and traced the p95 bottleneck to a missing index on the facility table, documented in the release performance report with the before-and-after measurements.

professionalSummary.text: Provided structured performance sign-off inputs for four releases as a checklist (scenarios run, thresholds met, open risks), with release approval remaining with the platform manager who used the inputs at the change advisory board.
professionalSummary.witness: Provided the performance sign-off inputs for four releases as a structured checklist (scenarios run, thresholds met, open risks); the release approval stayed with the platform manager, who used the inputs at the change advisory board.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated performance test windows with lending operations to avoid overlap with month-end processing, recording agreed windows and responsibility for test data in the test plan.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the performance test windows with lending operations so that batch runs did not overlap with month-end processing, recording the agreed windows and my responsibility for the test data in the test plan.

professionalSummary.text: Documented known limitations and hand-over conditions for each performance test cycle in the test plan and performance reports.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included load scenario design, bottleneck analysis, sign-off inputs and test-window coordination for the credit monitoring platform over about two years. Work sample: the performance report for one release (scenarios, metrics, p95 analysis, open risks) and the sign-off input checklist with the platform manager's approval note, with the test platform's run identifiers as a verification trail.

experienceHighlights.text: Over two years, delivered end-to-end performance engineering for the credit monitoring platform, including load scenario design, bottleneck analysis, sign-off inputs, and test-window coordination.
experienceHighlights.witness: Responsibilities included load scenario design, bottleneck analysis, sign-off inputs and test-window coordination for the credit monitoring platform over about two years.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Performance report for one release including scenarios, metrics, p95 analysis, open risks, and sign-off input checklist with platform manager's approval note, verified by test platform run identifiers.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the performance report for one release (scenarios, metrics, p95 analysis, open risks) and the sign-off input checklist with the platform manager's approval note, with the test platform's run identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Performance test platform usage, latency analysis, bottleneck identification, structured reporting, cross-functional coordination with lending operations.
skills.witness: Designed the load scenarios for the utilisation batch and the early-warning online queries using the team's performance test platform, collecting CPU, memory and database wait metrics for each run. Analysed latency distributions for the online queries and traced the p95 bottleneck to a missing index on the facility table, documented in the release performance report with the before-and-after measurements. Coordinated the performance test windows with lending operations so that batch runs did not overlap with month-end processing, recording the agreed windows and my responsibility for the test data in the test plan.
